shellCommands.command: git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls -la; head -c 600 package-lock.json
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu && ls; cat DropdownMenu.d.ts types.d.ts; sed -n 1,200p README.md 2>/dev/null | head -150; ls ../../../../ | head; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 1,80p uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts; grep -l . icons/package.json && grep '"version"' icons/package.json; ls icons/ | head; ls icons/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; for i in ChevronDown Pencil Copy ArrowShapeTurnUpRight TrashBin Archive; do ls icons/$i.js icons/esm/$i.js 2>/dev/null; done; grep -n "export" uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js | sed -n 1,140p; cat ArrowToggle/ArrowToggle.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "side" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/ButtonIcon.d.ts; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|testing-library"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
